name: Don't Look Up 3D
author: RomainIronGames
description:
In Don't Look Up 3d you have to complete various objectives at zero gravity in space.
Try to control your little explorer and go in search of materials, defend yourself against hordes of aliens, drill through huge asteroid to find treasures.
But watch your oxygen gauge , your survival cable, as well as the meteorites and hordes of aliens that are chasing you!
Explore, Collect, Survive! For free !

Features
- Innovative control with zero gravity!
- Various environnements!
- More than 200 levels to explore!
- Free forever!
